- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended the following time-tracking apps:

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] RescueTime: Helps understand time spent on different apps and websites, providing detailed productivity reports.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] TimeDoctor: Tracks time and monitors work activity, integrating with multiple project management tools.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Harvest: A time-tracking and invoicing app that tracks time spent on projects and tasks, with an expense tracking feature.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clockify: A free time-tracking app with a simple interface that can be used across devices.
- [USER] User requested tips on how to avoid burnout when working from home.
